# ── when-do-referral-bonuses-and-commissions-arrive-in-my (printed 2026-09-14 05:18)

Unlike affiliate programs that batch payments monthly, ether.fi Cash uses a **rolling payout system**. This means the moment your referred friend hits their $100 qualifying spend threshold, the payout clock starts ticking. You don't wait for a specific date on the calendar; you don't fill out a withdrawal form monthly. Commissions flow continuously to your ether.fi account as your referral uses their card.
column2: The moment your referred friend hits their $100 qualifying spend threshold, your payout eligibility is locked in. The schedule those commissions are then paid on is stated on the ether.fi affiliates page and nowhere else — check the current payout schedule there (verified 2026-09-14) rather than trusting a third-party summary of it.

column1: **Risk:** SCR is a cryptocurrency and subject to volatility. If you plan to convert to fiat (USD, EUR, etc.), the exchange rate at the time of conversion affects your net payouts. column2: **Risk:** If the payout asset is a volatile cryptocurrency rather than a stablecoin, the exchange rate at the moment you convert to fiat (USD, EUR, etc.) affects your net payouts — a commission can lose half its value between being earned and being converted.
